description: This file defines the SaveWorkShiftController class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin, responsible for setting up the Vue component with appropriate properties based on request parameters. It handles pre-render logic for saving or editing work shifts in the HRM system.

classes.name: SaveWorkShiftController
classes.description: Controller handling the logic for saving or editing work shift data, which sets up the Vue component with relevant properties during pre-rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with data needed for rendering the work shift save/edit interface, depending on whether an 'id' attribute is present in the request.
